title: process_ingress.v1
description: Shape of a compiled ingress: an intent expressed in prose, resolved to one registered process type plus the domain fields that type declares. Contingency slots are absent on purpose - they belong to the contract, not to the compilation.

process_id.description: The process type this intent resolves to.

fields.description: Domain aux fields for the act, keyed as the contract declares them.

missing.description: Fields the contract requires that the prose did not supply. Informational: the act registers either way, and the evaluator decides activation.

citations.description: Content hashes of the contract records this was compiled against - provenance for which version of the law was in force.

note.description: Optional short remark for the person, never a substitute for the rendered restatement.
